text: But the father caught the eye of a rich merchant, Lü Buwei, who decided that a prince in exile was an investment that could earn him a kingdom.
spoken: But the father caught the eye of a rich merchant, Lew Boo-way, who decided that a prince in exile was an investment that could earn him a kingdom.

pauzy.uwaga: brak pauzy w nagraniu — zostaje bez pauzy
